Right-side scope. While this scope is active, gain: 
• 15 Range
• 10 Zoom
• Charge Time is set to 633ms

Fires a single Bolt that chains up to 5 enemies within a 10 meter radius of the original target. Applies <arc/>Arc Blind to all enemies hit for 9 seconds. The chaining bolts deal 27% reduced damage.

This scope also displays charge status and remaining magazine ammo.
